text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Heh heh heh! I'mma switch the<n>caramel pudding
with savory egg<n>custard and everyone's gonna
totally<n>freak out!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Graaagh?! H-Hishiama?! Not good, I<n>gotta give her
the slip!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Hahaha! No need to run. I'm not<n>plannin' on
scolding you.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Eh? ...Y-you're not mad? Even<n>though I was about
to pull a prank?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Nope. You should live however you<n>choose to. I'll
just be here cheerin'<n>you on.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
It's a dorm leader's duty to support<n>her fellow
residents. There's no need<n>for me to get mad over
small stuff like<n>this.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
S-something's weird here! The<n>Hishiama I know
would never say<n>that!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
You always flip into a rage when I pull<n>pranks! And
when I run away, you<n>chase me like your life
depends on it!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
You're supposed to get angry!<n>What's wrong with
ya?!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Hang on a sec! I worked it<n>out—you're not angry
'cause you're<n>some kinda fake Hishiama!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Hahaha! That's a keen eye you have<n>there! Now
hurry and wake up—the<n>real world is waiting for
you!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Ngh... Urgh... Was that a dream?

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: ...Heh. I knew that couldn't be the real<n>Hishiama!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: The real Hishiama is way, waaayscarier! Those dumb dreams got along way to go before they can foolme!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Having seen through the deception in<n>her dream,
Shinko Windy's intuition<n>has grown sharper than
before,<n>making her quicker on her feet as<n>well.
